content.text: I'll explore the codebase to find the owner creation endpoint and trace through all validations and side-effects.

Here is the complete, ordered trace of what happens in `addOwner` (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:133-241`) when you `POST /api/owners`. I've marked each step as a **[validation]** (can reject the request) or **[side-effect]** (mutates/derives/persists/logs).

## Precondition
- **[validation]** Authorization — `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")`. Caller must hold the `OWNER_ADMIN` role or the request is rejected before any body logic runs.

## Required-field checks (accumulated, then thrown together)
1. **[side-effect]** `normalizeAddress(address)` is computed early (line 143) — trims, collapses internal whitespace, upper-cases, and expands street abbreviations (`ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`). A null/blank address becomes `""`.
2. **[validation]** `firstName` must be non-blank.
3. **[validation]** `lastName` must be non-blank.
4. **[validation]** the *normalized* `address` must be non-blank.
5. **[validation]** `city` must be non-blank.
6. **[validation]** `telephone` must be non-blank.
7. **[validation]** If any of the above are missing → `MissingOwnerFieldsException` (with the list of missing fields).

## Field-format and business-rule checks
8. **[validation]** `validatePostcode(city, postcode)` — postcode is optional; if present it must be 4 digits, and if the city maps to a known region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) it must fall in range → `InvalidPostcodeException`.
9. **[validation]** Future-date check — if `registrationDate` was supplied and is after `LocalDate.now()` → `FutureRegistrationDateException`.
10. **[side-effect]** Effective registration date derived: `toBusinessDay(supplied ?? today)` — rolls a Saturday/Sunday forward to the following Monday.
11. **[validation]** Daily registration limit — counts existing owners already registered on that (business-day) date; if ≥ 100 → `DailyRegistrationLimitException`.
12. **[side-effect]** `bulkSignupWarning` flag computed = `registeredOnDay > 80` (stored on the owner later).
13. **[validation]** City capacity — counts existing owners in the same city (case-insensitive); if ≥ 50 → `CityAtCapacityException`.

## Normalization written back to the DTO
14. **[side-effect]** DTO `address` set to the normalized address (from step 1).
15. **[validation + side-effect]** `toE164(telephone)` — strips spaces/dashes/brackets, keeps a leading `+`/country code or else drops one leading `0` and prepends `+61`; must be 8-15 digits and match the per-country national length (+61→9, +1→10) or `InvalidTelephoneException`. Normalized value set on DTO.
16. **[validation + side-effect]** `normalizeEmail(email)` — email is optional (blank → null); if present it must match the email pattern (else `InvalidEmailException`), is lower-cased, and its domain must not be on the disposable blocklist (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`) → `InvalidEmailException`. Normalized value set on DTO.

## Household / identity derivation and duplicate checks
17. **[side-effect]** `normalizeHousehold(lastName)` — trim, collapse whitespace, lower-case.
18. **[side-effect]** `householdId` derived = first 12 hex chars of SHA-256 over `normalizedLastName|postcode`.
19. **[side-effect]** Existing household members located (existing owners whose computed householdId matches).
20. **[validation]** Household-duplicate block — if the household already has members **and** the request did not set `sharesHousehold=true` → `DuplicateHouseholdException` (409).
21. **[side-effect]** `identityKey` derived = `IdentityKeyDeriver.identityKey(telephone, email, householdId)`.
22. **[validation]** Identity-duplicate block — if any existing owner has the same identity key → `DuplicateIdentityException` (409).

## Object construction and persistence
23. **[side-effect]** DTO mapped to an `Owner` entity (`ownerMapper.toOwner`).
24. **[side-effect]** `registrationDate` set (the business-day value from step 10).
25. **[side-effect]** `customerCode` set = `customerCode(postcode, telephone, lastName)` → `<REGION>-<HASH8>` (region from postcode; HASH8 = first 8 upper-hex of SHA-256 over telephone+lastName).
26. **[side-effect]** `householdId` set (step 18 value).
27. **[side-effect]** `namesakeCount` set = count of existing owners sharing first+last name (case-insensitive).
28. **[side-effect]** `bulkSignupWarning` set (step 12 value).
29. **[side-effect]** `householdSize` set = existing members + 1.
30. **[side-effect]** `possibleDuplicate` set to `false` and `possibleDuplicateOf` set to `null`.
31. **[side-effect]** **Persist** — `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` (assigns the id).
32. **[side-effect]** Owner mapped back to `OwnerDto` (which derives e.g. `membershipLevel`).
33. **[side-effect]** **Audit log** — `AUDIT.info(...)` records id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel.
34. **[side-effect]** `Location` header set to `/api/owners/{id}`.
35. Response returned as **201 Created** with the owner DTO.

### Notes on ordering that matter
- All five required-field checks are collected before throwing, so a request missing several fields reports all of them at once. But the other validations (postcode, date, limits, telephone, email, duplicates) are **short-circuit** — the first one that fails throws immediately, so e.g. an invalid telephone is never reported alongside an invalid email.
- The daily-limit and city-capacity counts, `namesakeCount`, and household-member lookup each independently call `findAllOwners()` and are all evaluated against the pre-existing owners (before this owner is saved).
- Telephone and email are validated **after** the count-based business rules (steps 11/13), so a request that would hit the daily/city limits is rejected before its phone/email format is ever checked.
